CFML Language Reference: Functions

DayOfWeek

Returns the weekday of a date/time value as a number, with Sunday as day 1.

Category

Date and time functions

Syntax

DayOfWeek(date)

Parameters

date
A date/time value or a string that can be converted to one.

Returns

A number from 1 (Sunday) to 7 (Saturday).

Usage

Pass the result to DayOfWeekAsString to get the name. Same as DatePart("w", date).

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Date</TH><TH>DayOfWeek</TH><TH>Name</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="D" LIST="12/31/1999,1/1/2000,2/29/2000">
<TR><TD>#D#</TD><TD>#DayOfWeek(D)#</TD><TD>#DayOfWeekAsString(DayOfWeek(D))#</TD></TR>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
<P>Today is day #DayOfWeek(Now())# of the week.</P>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

DayOfWeekAsString, DayOfYear, Day, DatePart
